## 📝 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Introduces changes from 0.9.0 to 1.0.0-RC3, migration guides (from 0.9 -> 1.0-RC3 and from maria/mysql -> postgres), and new SSO documentation.

It also introduces documentation versioning, and instructions for deploying a new version when adding a tag to the project.
